decisions.reason: After several years in a core garage-door segment, the accumulated investment, installed base and earlier visible commitment make management likely to continue the operator line rather than admit a mistaken launch.

As a niche but still complementary garage-door offering, it can be justified as portfolio breadth and customer customization, so management is inclined to retain it unless results become clearly untenable.

Although it overlaps with the broader operator range, it remains close to the firm's core business and management can still frame any weaker performance as a temporary or model-specific issue rather than grounds for withdrawal.
The glazed industrial sectional door supports the firm's stated direction of flexible, customer-near industrial solutions, and sunk development and sales effort encourage continued backing.
Because it received especially visible market presentation and sits squarely in the firm's industrial door competence, management is very likely to keep supporting it rather than reverse course.
